member.name: T:Storeasy.Application.Interfaces.ITransactionRunner
member.summary:
Runs a unit of database work inside a real transaction that the transaction interceptor opens on the (proxied) implementation. Handlers use this to keep ONLY their DB mutations transactional while doing external work (cache writes, notifications, e-mail) AFTER the commit, instead of wrapping the whole handler in [Transaction] (which would drag those external calls inside the transaction).
Milvasoft interception is proxy-based, so the transaction only fires when the method is invoked through this injected interface. A private [Transaction] method on the handler itself would NOT open a transaction: a same-instance call bypasses the proxy (self-invocation), so the interceptor never runs.
